messages:
Ana (AE): Orion POC: customer ran a high-parallel warmup and now sees TTFT spikes (~1.8s) and intermittent 429s. They used batch=36 and prefetch all prefixes. Can SE/SRE triage? :raising_hand:
Ravi (SE): On it. Which model and context lengths? Any client logs mentioning kv_lock or shard timeouts?
Ana (AE): Model: orion-12b, avg prompt ~250 tokens, peaks ~900. Client log shows repeated "kv_shard_lock_wait=1100ms" and gateway 429s clustered after their warmup run.
Marta (ML): That pattern fits KV cache lock contention + batch formation delay. Large batches + many prefetching clients expand the working set and cause LRU churn. For long contexts, decoding buffers also add memory pressure.
Zoe (SRE): Infra confirms spike in active requests at 2098765400. Our per-tenant concurrency gate returned 429s shortly after. Also saw router queueing and elevated KV eviction rate. We can temporarily raise their concurrency cap for a controlled replay, but we should recommend changes to the warmup script first.
Ravi (SE): Short-term guidance to send customer: 1) stop simultaneous prefetch; 2) reduce batch.max_requests to 8-12; 3) enable streaming=true to return first bytes sooner; 4) stage prefetch by shard or stagger clients with jitter. Example config:
```json
{"batch": {"max_requests": 12, "max_delay_ms": 10}, "prefetch": "staged", "stream": true}
```
Ana (AE): They also asked about Dedicated pricing for predictable throughput. Need a quick presales note to share.
Zoe (SRE): Dedicated isolates cache/egress noise and gives dedicated shard placement which reduces eviction from noisy neighbors. Quick thumb: entry Dedicated pod (8-GPU class) baseline ~ "$Mk/month". For POC we can offer a short trial with pre-warm; Sales Ops must confirm exact numbers.
Marta (ML): Also tell them to collect traces: include X-Trace-Id on a slow request and attach curl -v output. That will show where time is spent (gateway vs router vs runtime waiting on KV).
InfraBot: ops/tenant/orion-poc: temporary concurrency bump ready to apply on request.
Zoe (SRE): I can apply a bump from 20 -> 40 for 60 minutes during a controlled replay. I will monitor queue depth and eviction rate and rollback if eviction rate exceeds threshold.
Ana (AE): Actions: I'll send the client snippet and ask for 3 traces (warmup, steady, spike). Zoe will stand by to apply the brief concurrency bump if they want to replay. I'll loop Sales Ops for a Dedicated trial quote. Reopen if 429s/TTFT persist. :thumbsup:
